_about: Labour-hour productivity factors for the framing assemblies in materials/assemblies.json. Keys match that file exactly (interior_wall_2x4_16oc, exterior_wall_2x6_16oc, floor_system_ijoist_16oc). Each assembly is broken into the tasks needed to build it; each task carries a labour-hour factor per unit of work plus a role split for costing. These are typical published estimating productivity rates (the kind found in RSMeans / Craftsman National Construction Estimator), given as mid-range values with the documented ranges. Calibrate to your own crew's real production before you bid.
_units: Factors are LABOUR-HOURS (person-hours), NOT crew-hours. A crew of N working 1 hour = N labour-hours. Elapsed crew time = total labour-hours / crew size. Wages are paid per person-hour, so labour-hours are what multiplies by a wage. labour_takeoff.py reports both total labour-hours and elapsed crew time.
_scope: Covers carpentry to build the assembly: framing, sheathing, weather-resistive barrier, batt insulation, vapour barrier, and drywall HANGING. Explicitly EXCLUDED: drywall taping/mudding/sanding, priming/painting, electrical/plumbing/HVAC rough-in, doors/windows/trim, exterior cladding, and site cleanup/mobilization. Those are separate line items or trades.
_conditions: Rates assume normal ground-floor work, standard 8 ft walls, reasonable access, and an experienced crew. Multiply by a conditions factor for hard cases (high walls, cold weather, tight access, heavy openings): typical adjustments 1.10-1.40. Pass --factor on the CLI to apply one; default is 1.0.
_ontario_note: Productivity is a physics/labour fact and does not change by jurisdiction. But how those hours are PAID and scheduled in Ontario does: verify overtime, breaks, stat holidays and hours-of-work against the current Ontario Employment Standards Act (ESA), and add WSIB premiums plus labour burden (see wages.example.json). This file does not model those; it only estimates hours.

linear_assemblies._unit: labour-hours per linear foot of wall, at the assembly's nominal height (8 ft)

interior_wall_2x4_16oc.label: Interior partition, 2x4 SPF, 16" O.C., 8 ft - labour

layout & wall framing (plates, studs, bl.note: Snap lines, cut and set plates, install studs at 16" O.C., blocking; build in place. ~0.10 lh per lin ft of 8 ft wall.

hang drywall 1/2\" (both faces).note: Hang only, no tape/mud. ~0.011 lh/sqft x 16 sqft/ft (two faces x 8 ft). Taping/finishing is a separate trade and is NOT included.

exterior_wall_2x6_16oc.label: Exterior load-bearing wall, 2x6 SPF, 16" O.C., 8 ft - labour

layout & wall framing (plates, studs, bl.note: Heavier 2x6 load-bearing wall; more careful layout, openings and lifting than a partition. ~0.14 lh per lin ft.

install OSB sheathing 7/16\".note: ~0.012 lh/sqft x 8 sqft/ft (one face x 8 ft).

install house wrap (WRB).note: ~0.004 lh/sqft x 8.8 sqft/ft. Verify WRB detailing to OBC.

install batt insulation R-22.note: ~0.006 lh/sqft x 8 sqft/ft. Confirm required R-value against OBC SB-12 for the climate zone.

install 6 mil poly vapour barrier.note: ~0.004 lh/sqft x 8.8 sqft/ft, including acoustic sealant at laps/penetrations.

hang drywall 1/2\" (interior face).note: Hang only, one face. ~0.011 lh/sqft x 8 sqft/ft. Taping/finishing NOT included.

area_assemblies._unit: labour-hours per square foot of floor area

floor_system_ijoist_16oc.label: Floor system, wood I-joist @ 16" O.C., glued/screwed subfloor - labour

set I-joists, rim board & hangers.note: Layout, hangers, set joists at 16" O.C., rim board, bridging/blocking. ~0.018 lh/sqft. Joist sizing/spans must come from the manufacturer/engineer.

glue & screw T&G subfloor 3/4\".note: Bead adhesive on every joist, lay and screw sheets. ~0.012 lh/sqft.
